channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 19-Minute Viral Video Triggers Outrage in India, Highlights Voyeurism and Gendered Blame
item.description: The 19-minute viral video sparked outrage, exposing how gendered blame and voyeurism persist in India.

item.title: “Women Are Only for Sleeping With Husbands”: Kerala CPI(M) Leader’s Misogynistic Remark Triggers Widespread Outrage
item.description: A CPI(M) leader’s misogynistic remark during a victory speech after a narrow panchayat win in Kerala has sparked widespread political and social backlash.

item.title: Nine-Year-Old Eiha Dixit Transforms Barren Lands into Mini Forests Through Tireless Tree Planting Mission
item.description: A nine-year-old from Meerut transforms barren lands into thriving green spaces through her innovative foundation, earning top national and international accolades.

item.title: Four Killed, 25 Injured After Multiple Vehicles Collide, Catch Fire in Dense Fog on Delhi–Agra Expressway
item.description: Dense fog on the Yamuna Expressway caused a deadly pile-up of ten vehicles, claiming four lives and injuring 25 people.

item.title: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar Sparks Outrage After Viral Video Shows Him Pulling Down Hijab of Muslim Woman Doctor at Patna Event
item.description: At a Patna government event, Bihar CM Nitish Kumar pulled down a Muslim doctor’s hijab on stage, igniting nationwide debate over consent, dignity and constitutional rights.

item.title: TV Actor Anuj Sachdeva Allegedly Attacked by Neighbour Over Parking, Dog Targeted in Goregaon Society Clash
item.description: Mumbai TV actor chased, beaten with stick by Goregaon neighbour over parking flag; dog attacked amid death threats.

item.title: At Least Seven Killed as Private Jet Crashes During Emergency Landing in Central Mexico Industrial Area
item.description: At least seven people died after a small private jet crashed in Mexico, attempting an emergency landing near Toluca.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Students Hold Protest in Prayagraj Against UPPSC, Raise Demands Over Exam Irregularities
item.description: Hundreds of civil services aspirants in Prayagraj are accusing UPPSC of opaque, error‑ridden exams and demanding transparent disclosure of cut‑offs, marks and answer sheets.

item.title: Quick Action by Mumbai Police Helps Recover German National’s Lost Passport, Visa and Cash from Taxi Within An Hour
item.description: Mumbai Police and an honest driver returned a German national's forgotten passport and cash within one hour.

item.title: Mohali Kabaddi Horror: Bikers Pose for Selfie, Then Fire 7 Bullets Killing Star Rana Balachauria
item.description: Motorcycle assailants posed for selfies, then shot kabaddi promoter dead at Punjab tournament gang links to Sidhu Moose Wala murder.
